item.title: AKU Graduates Over 400 Students and Installs Princess Zahra Aga Khan as Pro-Chancellor
item.description: The Aga Khan University graduated 461 students from 18 degree programmes at its 38th Convocation in Pakistan and formally installed Princess Zahra Aga Khan as the University’s first Pro-Chancellor.
